- Ticket OMN-20543. omnibase_core#1886 (merged) gives the reusable workflow job "dod-verify" in omnibase_core .github/workflows/receipt-gate.yml a postgres:16-alpine service, the PostgreSQL 16 server tools on PATH, and INTEGRATION_POSTGRES_* environment variables, before the head verification step, so a bound test that needs a database runs at the pull request head and in the merge-base must-fail control.

## Why
Ticket OMN-20543 requires bound tests to run against a database. omnibase_core#1886 adds a postgres:16-alpine service and PostgreSQL 16 tools to the dod-verify job. Previously, omnimarket#3369 had to skip real-Postgres evidence items because the hosted verifier lacked database access, causing control failures.

## Change
This PR pins the reusable workflow in .github/workflows/call-repo-evidence-gate.yml to the squash commit of omnibase_core#1886. It updates tests/ci/test_repo_evidence_caller_workflow.py with test_caller_pins_a_reusable_that_gives_bound_tests_a_database. It adds contracts/OMN-20543.yaml binding AC3 to that test.
